integrity: Analytic all-finite-size proof with exact rational and independent quadrature checks in verify.py; no independent external mathematical validation claimed.
scientific_limitations: Finite real Fourier cutoffs, periodic linear Edwards–Wilkinson field, shared homogeneous Poisson global resets to zero, independent Gaussian thermal noises.
Exact ensemble covariances rather than finite-sample estimators; known diffusivity and period required for absolute reset-rate identification.
The diagonal observable is sine–cosine squared-energy covariance and not one-energy variance; arbitrary positive energy weights preserve signs.
The Gaussian reset-age mixture and classical Cauchy determinant are known inputs; novelty concerns their fourth-order modal interface consequence and calibrated inverse.
title: Strict total positivity and rate tomography from jointly reset Fourier-mode energies
